name: 智能配额轮换调度器 (Smart Quota Rotator)
description: 满额自动负载均衡，临期优先榨干重置，支持多号并行防打爆。周限100%账号轮询，降至≤99%自动切换刷新倒计时最短账号优先；0%周限与短窗耗尽硬避让。 / Full-capacity load balancing, reset-soon first quota drain, and multi-account parallel protection. Stage 1 round-robin for 100% accounts; Stage 2 reset-soon first for ≤99% accounts; strict bypass on 0% quota or short-window exhaustion.
author: daodeqing
